11300.full:
αἱρετικός, -ή, όν
(αἱρέομαι),
__1. capable of choosing (Plat.).
__2. causing division, heretical, factious (Cremer, 614): as subst., Tit.3:10.
† (AS)

11303.full:
Νικόπολις, -εως, ἡ
Nicopolis, prob. the city of that name in Epirus (CGT, in l): Tit.3:12†
(AS)

s: to be still owing, be still due
11307.full: to owe besides or still , (Thucydides): absolute, προσοφείλοντας ἡμᾶς ἐνέγραψεν (Demosthenes Orator):—;Pass. to be still owing, be still due , (Thucydides); so, ἡ ἔχθρη ἡ προσοφειλομένη ἐς Ἀθηναίους ἐκ τῶν Αἰγινητέων the hatred which was still due from the Aeginetans to the Athenians, i. e. their ancient feud, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

11308.full:
πολυμερῶς
adv. (πολύς, μέρος),
in many parts or portions: Heb.1:1 (Plut., al.).†
(AS)

11309.full:
πολυτρόπως
adv. (πολύτροπος, 1. much turning. 2. manifold ), [in LXX: 4Ma.3:21 A * ;]
in many ways or manners: Heb.1:1 (Philo).†
(AS)

11310.full:
μισθαποδοσία, -ας, ἡ
(μισθός, ἀποδίδωμι; cl. μισθοδοσία),
pay­ment of wages, recompense; meton.,
__(a) of reward: Heb.10:35 11:26;
__(b) of punishment : Heb.2:2.†
(AS)

s: to join in attesting, bear witness together with
11311.full:
συν-επι-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ
to join in attesting, bear witness together with: Heb.2:4 (Arist., Polyb., a1.).†
(AS)

s: critical, able to discern or judge
11315.full:
κριτικός, -ή, -όν
(κρίνω),
critical, able to discern or judge: with genitive obj., Heb.4:12.†
(AS)

11316.full:
τραχηλίζω
(τράχηλος),
prop., of wrestlers,
to take by the throat, hence (Philo), to prostrate, overthrow. Metaphorical, but in what sense and from what age it is doubtful (see Westc., Rendall, on He, l.with; DB, iii, 625n), τραχηλισμένα, laid open (RV, Westc.; downcast, Rendall): Heb.4:13.†
(AS)

s: to hold one's passions or emotions in restraint; hence, to bear gently with, feel gently towards
11317.full:
μετριοπαθέω, -ῶ
(μετριοπαθής, moderating one's passions),
to hold one's passions or emotions in restraint; hence, to bear gently with, feel gently towards: Heb.5:2.†
(AS)

s: to raise on a cross, crucify
11320.full:
ἀνα-σταυρόω
__1. to impale (Hdt.).
__2. to raise on a cross, crucify (Polyb., al.).
__3. to crucify again: Heb.6:6 (see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

s: without father , i.e., with no recorded genealogy
11322.full:
ἀπάτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ὴ
(ἀ- neg., πατήρ)
__1. fatherless.
__2. without father (MM, VGT, see word), i.e., with no recorded genealogy: Heb.7:3.†
(AS)

11323.full:
ἀμήτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ἡ
(μήτηρ), without a mother (frequently in Gk. writers of the gods): ἀπάτωρ ἀ.
of one without recorded genealogy, Heb.7:3 (cf. MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)

11324.full:
ἀγενεαλόγητος, -ον
(γενεαλογέω),
without genealogy, i.e. without recorded pedigree (cf. Neh.7:64): Heb.7:3 (Cremer, 152; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

11325.full:
ἀκροθίνιον, -ου, τό
(ἄκρος, θίς, a heap),
prop., the top of a heap, hence, in pl.,
__1. first-fruits (Xen.; MM, VGT, see word).
__2. In war, the choicest spoils (cf. Hdt., viii, 121 f.): Heb.7:4.
† (AS)

s: a bringing in besides or in addition
11328.full:
ἐπ-εισ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
a bringing in besides or in addition (Hipp., FlJ, al.): Heb.7:19 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

11329.full:
ἀ-παρά-βατος, -ον
(παραβαίνω),
inviolable, and so unchangeable: Heb.7:24 (see Westc., in l; Cremer, 653; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

11332.full:
αἱματεκχυσία, -ας, ἡ
(αἷμα, ἐκ, χέω),
shedding of blood (Eccl.; Cremer, 71): Heb.9:22.†
(AS)

s: active striking back; metaphorically, resisting, adverse
11333.full:
ἀντί-τυπος, -ον
(see: τύπος), [in LXX: Est.3:13 A * ;]
__1. active striking back; metaphorically, resisting, adverse.
__2. Pass. struck back; metaphorically, corres­ponding to (MM, VGT, see word);
__(a) as impression of a seal or copy of an archetype (τύπος) (RV, Like in pattern), Heb.9:24;
__(b) as the reality (of which τύπος is the copy or adumbration) (RV, after a true likeness), 1Pe.3:21 (Cramer, 357).†
(AS)

11334.full:
ἐκ-δοχή ῆς, ἡ
(ἐκδέχομαι);
__1. in cl.,
__(a) a receiving from, succession;
__(b) an interpretation.
__2. In NT, = προσδοκία, expectation: Heb.10:27 (cf. Field, Notes, 231; Cremer, 688).†
(AS)

11336.full:
ἄθλησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀθλέω),
a contest, combat, esp. of athletes; figuratively, a struggle: Heb.10:32 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

s: to make a spectacle of, expose to contempt
11337.full:
θεατρίζω
(θέατρον),
to make a spectacle of, expose to contempt (eccl.; ἐκθ-, Polyb.): pass., Heb.10:33.†
(AS)

11338.full:
ὑπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὑποστέλλω),
__1. a letting down, lowering (Plut.).
__2. a shrinking back (Hesych.): οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑποστολῆς (on the genitive, see Bl., § 35, 2), Heb.10:39.†
(AS)

11339.full:
μισθ-απο-δότης, -ου, ὁ
(see supr.),
one who pays wages; meton., a rewarder: Heb.11:6.†
(AS)

11341.full:
συν-κακουχέομαι (Rec. συγκ-), -οῦμαι, pass.
to endure adversity with: with dative of person(s), Heb.11:25. Not elsewhere.†
(AS)

11343.full:
κατ-αγωνίζομαι depon., "perfective" compound (M, Pr., 116);
__1. to struggle against.
__2. to conquer, overcome: Heb.11:33.†
(AS)

11345.full:
ὄγκος, -ου, ὁ
bulk, mass; metaphorically, an encumbrance: Heb.12:1.†
SYN.: βάρος, a weight; φορτίον, a burden, that which is borne (AS)

11346.full:
εὐ-περί-στατος, -ον
(εὖ, περιΐστημι),
of sins, readily besetting: Heb.12:1 (on form and sense of the word, see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

11348.full:
ἐκ-λανθάνω
[in Sm.: Psa.13:2 * ;]
to escape notice utterly; mid., to forget utterly: Heb.12:5.†
(AS)

s: in Hom, the gloom of the under-world; hence, darkness, deep gloom
11349.full:
ζόφος, -ου, ὁ
(akin to γνόφος, which see), [in Sm.: Exo.10:22, Job.28:3, Psa.11:2 91:6, Isa.59:9 * ;]
in Hom, the gloom of the under-world; hence, darkness, deep gloom (poët. and late prose writers): Heb.12:18, 2Pe.2:4 2:17, Ju 6 13.†
ὁμίχλη, -ης, ἡ,
[in LXX for עֲרָפֶל, etc. ;]
a mist: 2Pe.2:17
SYN.: νέφος, νεφέλη, both thicker than ὁ (AS)

11351.full:
εὐ-ποιία (Rec. -ιΐα), -ας, ἡ
__1. beneficence, doing good: Heb.13:16.
__2. a benefit (FlJ, Ant., ii, ll, 2, al.).†
(AS)

11353.full:
εἴκω (obsolete pres.), see: ἔοικα Transcriber note: This form does not occur in Abbott-Smith. It should be on p. 158..
(AS)

s: to be driven by the wind
11354.full:
ἀνεμίζω = Attic ἀνεμόω
(ἄνεμος);
pass.,
to be driven by the wind: Jas.1:6.†
(AS)

s: to be tossed or blown by the wind
11355.full:
ῥιπίζω
(ῥιπίς, a fan) [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:35 (נְשָׂא) * ;]
primarily, to fan a fire, hence generally, to make a breeze (Plut., al.). In pass. (cf. Philo, de inter. round., 24), to be tossed or blown by the wind: of waves, ἀνεμιζομένῳ καὶ ῥιπιζομένῳ, blown and raised with the wind (Hort, in l), Jas.1:6.†
(AS)

11357.full:
απείραστος, -ον
(πειράζω for cl. ἀπείρητος, πειράω),
untempted, untried, without experience: Jas.1:13 (see Hort, in l; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

11358.full:
δελεάζω
(δέλεαρ, a bait),
to allure by a bait: metaphorically, to allure, entice: with accusative, 2Pe.2:14, 18; pass., Jas.1:14.†
(AS)

11359.full:
παρ-αλλαγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(παραλλάσσω), [in LXX: 4Ki.9:20 (שִׁגָּעוֹן)* ;]
in various senses (LS, see word), change: Jas.1:17.†
(AS)

11360.full:
ἀπο-σκίασμα, -τος, τό
(ἀποσκιάζω, to cast a shadow; v,s. σκία)
a shadow: Jas.1:17 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

11362.full:
θρῆσκος
(-κός, WH), -ον, ό
religious, careful of the outward forms of divine service (see previous word)): Jas.1:26.†
SYN.: εὐσεβής, θεοσεβής, δεισιδαίμων (see Tr., Syn., § xlviii) (AS)

11363.full:
χαλιναγωγέω, -ῶ
(χαλινός, ἄγω),
to lead with a bridle; metaphorically, to bridle, restrain: with accusative, γλῶσσαν, Jas.1:26; σῶμα, Jas.3:2.†
(AS)

11365.full:
προσωπολημπτέω (Rec. -ληπτ-), -ῶ
(-λήμπτης, which see),
to have respect of persons: Jas.2:9.†
(AS)

11367.full:
ἐφ-ήμερος, -ον
(ἐπί, ἡμέρα),
__1. lasting for a day.
__2. daily, for the day: Jas.2:15.†
(AS)

11368.full:
αὐχέω, -ῶ,
(αὔχη, boasting),
to boast: with accusative (MM, see word), μεγάλα αὐχεῖ (Rec. μεγαλαυχεῖ, which see), Jas.3:5.†
(AS)

11369.full:
ἐν-άλιος, -ον
(also -α, -ον; ἅλς, the sea),
of the sea: τὰ ἐ., marine creatures, Jas.3:7.†
(AS)

s: Of springs, to gush with water
11370.full:
βρύω, poët., late prose and vernac.,
to be full to bursting;
__1. of the earth producing vegetation.
__2. Of plants putting forth buds.
__3. Of springs, to gush with water: Jas.3:11.
† (AS)

11373.full:
to turn around
Some manuscripts list μεταστρέφω (G3344) in place of G6060 at Jas.4.9

11376.full:
ἀνα-γεννάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sir prol.17 א* (ΑΒאc παρα-)* ;]
to beget again: metaphorically, of spiritual birth, 1Pe.1:3 1:23 (cf. Cremer, 147; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

11378.full:
προ-μαρτύρομαι
to protest beforehand (cf. μαρτύρομαι, and V. Hort, in l): 1Pe.1:11 (elsewhere only in Theod. Met., xiv/AD.).†
(AS)

11379.full:
ἀπροσωπολήμπτως (Rec. -λήπτως, cl.), adv.
(α- neg., προσωπολήμπτης),
without respect of persons, impartially: 1Pe.1:17.†
(AS)

s: handed down from one's fathers, inherited
11380.full:
πατρο-παρά-δοτος, -ον
(πατήρ, παραδίδωμι),
handed down from one's fathers, inherited: 1Pe.1:18 (Diod., al.).†
(AS)

11382.full:
ἐπ-οπτεύω
[in Sm.: Psa.10:14 33:13 * ;]
to watch (in Hom., as an overseer; cf Ps, ll. with), look upon: 1Pe.2:12 3:2.†
(AS)

11383.full:
ἀδίκως, adv.
(ἄδικος), [in LXX for שׁקר, עול, etc. ;]
unjustly, undeservedly: 1Pe.2:19.†
(AS)

11384.full:
ὑπο-λιμτάνω
collat. form of ὑπολείπω,
to leave behind: 1Pe.2:21.†
(AS)

11385.full: to rail at or abuse in turn , (New Testament); Mid., with accusative rei, (Lucian) (ML)

11386.full:
ἀπο-γίνομαι (cl. -γίγν-)
[in LXX: Da TH Dan.2:1 * ;]
__1. to be away, removed from.
__2. to depart life, to die (MM, see word): τ. ἀμαρτίαις, i.e. with ref. to sins, 1Pe.2:24 (Cremer, 149, 668).†
(AS)

11388.full:
περί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(περιτίθημι), [in Sm.: Psa.32:9 * ;]
a putting around, putting on: 1Pe.3:3.†
(AS)

11390.full:
ταπεινόφρων, -ον
(ταπεινός, φρήν), [in LXX: Pro.29:23 (רוּחַ שָׁפָל)* ;]
humble-minded: 1Pe.3:8 (in bad sense, Plut., 2, 336 E, cf. Deiss., LAE, 72.3).†
(AS)

11392.full:
ὁπλίζω
(ὅπλον), [in Sm.: Jer.52:25 * ;]
to make ready, equip; of soldiers, to arm. Mid., to arm oneself; figuratively, ἔννοιαν: 1Pe.4:1 (cf. θράσος ὁ., Soph., Elec., 995), (cf. καθ-ὁπλίζω).†
(AS)

11393.full:
οἰνοφλυγία, -ας, ἡ
(φλύω, to bubble up, overflow), cf. -γέω, Deu.21:20
drunkenness, debauchery: 1Pe.4:3.†
SYN.: see: κραιπάλη (AS)

11394.full:
ἀνά-χυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναχέω, to pour out),
a pouring out, overflowing, excess: metaphorically, 1Pe.4:4 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

s: one who meddles in things alien to his calling
11395.full:
ἀλλοτρι-επίσκοπος (Rec. ἀλλοτριοεπ-), -ου, ὁ
one who meddles in things alien to his calling: 1Pe.4:15 (see ICC, in l; Deiss., BS, 224-4; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

11398.full:
ἀναγκαστῶς
adv.,
necessarily or by constraint: opposite to ἑκουσίως, 1Pe.5:2 (rare).†
(AS)
